items.title: Standard Chartered Sets $10 Price Target on ARB
points: Standard Chartered published a $10 price target for ARB token, a major bullish signal from a top-tier institutional bank.
Arbitrum is a layer-2 scaling solution (a secondary blockchain built on top of Ethereum that processes transactions faster and cheaper) and one of crypto's largest platforms by total value locked.
Institutional price targets from legacy finance firms carry weight in crypto markets and can influence other institutions' allocation decisions.

items.title: Clarity Act Fails in Senate Cloture Vote
points: Cloture vote failed Tuesday with fewer than 60 Senate votes, blocking the Digital Asset Market Structure bill from floor debate.

The bill would have created a statutory test to classify crypto assets as securities versus commodities and expanded CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission) jurisdiction over digital asset spot markets, ending a multi-year SEC–CFTC dispute.
Without passage, regulators continue operating under enforcement-driven guidance, pushing market structure resolution to the next legislative session at earliest.

items.title: DOJ Charges Robinhood Engineers with Front-Running via Derivatives
points: DOJ charged engineers Hefu Chai and Huaisong Xiang with commodities and wire fraud for misappropriating confidential listing information and trading perpetual futures (leveraged crypto contracts that derive value from an underlying asset without owning it) on Hyperliquid ahead of announcements between 2025 and 2026.
Each engineer profited over $50,000; both face up to 10 years under the Commodity Exchange Act and up to 20 years for wire fraud.
This is the first such case involving perpetuals rather than spot tokens, establishing that insiders cannot evade securities and commodities laws by trading through derivatives.

items.title: Aave V4 Proposes Custodied Collateral Lending Hub
points: Aave Labs proposed a V4 Isolated Hub allowing institutional borrowers to use assets custodied at Anchorage (a third-party custody provider) as collateral for onchain stablecoin loans without moving assets to blockchain.

Custodied balance is represented by a non-transferable Custodied Collateral Token (CoCT), minted and burned by a Chainlink-built CustodySync contract that reconciles custody state with onchain state each cycle.

The hub is fully isolated from existing Aave markets; the CoCT draw cap is permanently zero so collateral cannot be borrowed out, and liquidation runs as an OTC (over-the-counter, direct peer-to-peer) sale executed by Anchorage with proceeds settling onchain atomically.

items.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act Imposes 24-Hour Reporting on Wallet Makers
points: The EU's Cyber Resilience Act imposes 24-hour vulnerability reporting requirements on crypto wallet makers.
Penalties for violations can reach €15 million or 2.5% of global revenue.

items.title: Robinhood Chain Hits $1B TVL Mainly Through DeFi Traders, Not Retail Migration
points: Robinhood Chain reached nearly $1 billion total value locked (TVL) and $1.88 billion in daily DEX volume since its July 1 launch, capturing more than half of all Uniswap volume with 72% monthly stablecoin growth.

Growth was driven by brand recognition from viral CEO moments, permissionless token issuance (about 25,000 launches in a single day), gas fee subsidies on wallet swaps above $5, and community platforms pairing memecoins with tokenized equities.

Crypto-native traders account for 98–99% of chain transactions, meaning Robinhood's existing retail brokerage customers have not meaningfully migrated; growth came from capturing established DeFi participants instead.
